hardware: NVIDIA RTX 3080 10 GiB; Windows WDDM; driver 610.88; CUDA runtime 12.9
active_link: PCIe Gen4 x16 in both steady decode profiles
calibration_protocol: cudaHostAllocMapped, cached (same host-allocation flags as the fork on Windows); cudaMalloc device buffer; nonblocking stream; four warmup copies; five trials of 8 GiB per direction and chunk size. CUDA event and host wall times recorded. Endpoint data checks passed. Allocation and host initialization excluded. Pageable 256 MiB comparison included.
units: GB/s decimal; MiB binary. Directions from the GPU viewpoint: RX is host to GPU, TX is GPU to host.

nvml_counter_calibration.reason: NVML reports more than the Gen4 x16 physical limit during a known-byte timed copy, even using decimal kB. Therefore raw NVML values are diagnostic only; no literal MTP3 bus-utilization percentage is claimed. The reason for this counter discrepancy is unproven.

inference_protocol: Fresh 128K server per mode; same model, fitted arenas 1440 MiB off and 1078 MiB MTP3; 8 CPU threads; batch/ubatch128; Q8_0 K/Q4_0 V; no mmproj; no UVM; existing user-confirmed Prefer No Sysmem Fallback profile; warmup256/4 then130801-token prompt and256 outputs. NVML sampling nominal20ms; report uses steady decode after first token+1s to request end-0.25s.

profiles.estimation_note: MTP off: logged bytes/evaluation times measured output rate; one target evaluation per output interval, with small growth/padding approximation. This is KV payload, not an exact counter of all PCIe traffic. MTP3 is left unestimated because evaluations can produce multiple tokens and draft traffic is additional.

MTP off: logged bytes/evaluation times measured output rate; one target evaluation per output interval, with small growth/padding approximation. This is KV payload, not an exact counter of all PCIe traffic. MTP3 is left unestimated because evaluations can produce multiple tokens and draft traffic is additional.

source_accounting: src/llama-kv-stream-resident.cpp refresh(): KV_reload upload_us covers existing synchronous tensor uploads and bookkeeping. accepted KV layout copied reports one sequence/evaluation, not all output tokens. copy_ms is only sampled traffic and must not divide the full sequence byte count.
interpretation: Large KV reload bursts reach approximately the standalone pinned-transfer reference. The MTP-off KV-payload average is below that reference; this does not by itself measure every bus transaction or establish the dominant stall cause. No Windows-vs-Linux comparison was performed.
